Method of Attack: Injects highly convincing PayPal iframes to hijack the checkout process on compromised online stores
Captures order form data entered by victims and exfiltrates it to attacker-controlled servers
Uses stolen order data to pre-fill fake PayPal payment forms during checkout
Removes malicious iframes if parsed data is invalid
Clicks the legitimate order button behind the malicious iframe to send victim back to legitimate checkout
Attack Vector: Injected JavaScript-based skimmer script hidden inside an image on compromised store's server using steganography
